content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments for digital products represent a significant shift in how creators can transact online. Traditional platforms often impose hefty fees, such as Gumroad's 10% on every sale. In contrast, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, allowing creators to retain a larger share of their earnings. For example, if you sell a product priced at $97 and achieve 100 sales a month, the fee difference allows you to keep an additional $921. This is not just about cost savings; it’s about reclaiming financial control and independence.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for Solana payments relies on a combination of decentralized technologies that ensure efficiency and security. By leveraging Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can build a seamless sales process. Each transaction occurs instantly, with automatic verification on the blockchain, minimizing delays. This architecture not only enhances security but also guarantees that creators maintain full ownership and control of their data and products, creating a more sovereign digital commerce environment.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is particularly beneficial for digital creators who have been locked out by traditional payment processors. Artists selling ebooks, course creators, and template designers in regions like Pakistan or Venezuela now have an avenue to monetize their work without relying on platforms that charge high fees or impose restrictive regulations. By using a Solana payments infrastructure, these creators can focus on their craft while confidently managing their online sales with the assurance that they won’t be subjected to arbitrary platform policy changes.
Now you can keep more of your earnings with lower transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The framework for Solana payments integrates several key components. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free hosting for your product listings, while backend functionality is powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Product orders are efficiently stored in databases like Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring easy access and management. File delivery can be handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, creating a cohesive system for selling digital products. The combination of these tools forms a robust and scalable commerce stack tailored to the needs of digital creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with Solana payments, first choose the right tools for your needs. Begin by setting up a website using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing and select appropriate storage solutions like Supabase. Finally, upload your digital products, and start selling. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes comprehensive blueprints and templates to guide you through this process and ensure a successful deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize Solana payments through a sovereign digital commerce stack. This allows you to accept automatic crypto payments with low fees. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare Workers, GitHub Pages, and NOWPayments, you can create a fully operational online store without the constraints of traditional platforms.
Create a sovereign store without relying on traditional platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those interested in selling digital products independently, exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) can provide all the resources needed to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack. This is especially useful for creators looking to establish a resilient sales platform without relying on traditional payment processors. Check out the options available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
